_doc: Owned by AI-C. Train map text per car id. Shape: {cars:{car_id:{name,desc(<=70),lock_hint}}}. lock_hint is shown only while the car is locked (unlock tiers: sleep 1, obs 2, lug 3); lp/pass/dine are open at the start and have no hint.

car_obs.name: Observation
car_obs.desc: Big windows, quiet chairs, and a very good view of nowhere.
car_obs.lock_hint: The windows are shuttered for now. A little more reputation and someone will open them.

car_sleep.name: Sleeper
car_sleep.desc: Curtained bunks where things slip down the back.
car_sleep.lock_hint: The curtains are drawn. Return a few more things and the porter will let you in.

car_lp.name: Lost Property
car_lp.desc: Your counter, your bench, your lamp. Home, more or less.

car_pass.name: Passenger
car_pass.desc: Rows of seats, each one hiding something small.

car_dine.name: Dining
car_dine.desc: Tea, cutlery and the odd glove under a tablecloth.

car_lug.name: Luggage
car_lug.desc: Racks and trunks, and the heaviest things people forget.
car_lug.lock_hint: The door is locked and the key is with the guard. Keep building your name.
